name: Arcadian Shopping Center
summary: Arcadian Shopping Center is a 137,259-square-foot community center in Ossining, New York, anchored by Stop & Shop and Westchester Community College. Located at the busy intersection of Route 9 and Rockledge Avenue, the center attracts over 2.2 million annual visits from surrounding Westchester County residents and students.
demographics: Arcadian Shopping Center serves a diverse suburban population of over 43,000 residents within a 3-mile radius in Westchester County, with a daytime population of approximately 35,500. The trade area attracts middle to upper-middle income families and professionals working in the greater New York metropolitan area, as well as college students from Westchester Community College located on-site. The center's anchors, including Stop & Shop grocery store, cater to everyday shopping needs of local households seeking convenience and value, while the presence of the community college brings a younger demographic for quick-service dining and essential services.
description: Arcadian Shopping Center is a well-established community shopping destination strategically located at the signalized intersection of Route 9 (South Highland Avenue) and Rockledge Avenue in Ossining, New York, within affluent Westchester County. Spanning 137,259 square feet, this open-air center serves as a vital retail and educational hub, anchored by Stop & Shop supermarket and Westchester Community College, which together generate over 2.2 million annual visits. The center's prime location along a major thoroughfare provides excellent visibility and accessibility for the surrounding residential communities and commuters traveling through the Hudson Valley region. Managed by Regency Centers, a nationally recognized shopping center developer and operator, Arcadian Shopping Center benefits from professional management and strategic tenant curation that meets the daily needs of local families, students, and professionals. With convenient access, ample parking, and a tenant mix focused on essential services and everyday shopping, the center has established itself as a reliable neighborhood destination in northern Westchester County.
